verdict.rationale: Greptile is itself a built-in AI agent that takes on delegated work automatically. It reviews every PR (docs-1, docs-26), generates unit tests and diagrams (docs-18, docs-17), and runs PR branches in a sandbox via TREX (docs-19, docs-51); a user confirms it catches real issues (comm-13), and another got a useful answer to a codebase question (comm-1). The delegation is limited to these fixed review-centric tasks, though. Applying fixes is handed off to external agents like Claude Code or Cursor rather than done in-product (docs-2, docs-36). missing for 10: general-purpose, user-directed task delegation to an in-product assistant, in-product fix execution rather than handoff to third-party agents, documentation of a conversational assistant interface.
